name: Assurance transport / verification-artifact substrate (AX-21)
families: prose-spec-only: design assurance by documents and human review
LLM-as-judge-assurance: model scoring/critique as the assurance verdict
benchmark-only-assurance: test suites and leaderboard deltas as the sole evidence for correctness claims

per-output-translation-validation: verify each emitted artifact against its spec rather than verifying the generator (absorbs: Alive2/TRACTOR pattern, proof-carrying certificates trust-boundary architecture with assumption-tiered certificate algebra, typed CoT faithfulness certificates, round-trip drift detection as standing invariant, differential random testing against the formal model)

verified-kernel-chain: machine-checked proofs replayable by a small kernel (offline Lean 4 for the admission kernel and calculus metatheory) + verified compilation where it exists (CompCert/CakeML; DO-178C-qualified credit) + vericoding for spec-to-source legs (absorbs: verified argumentation-kernel candidate, small verified checker for the defeasible legal calculus candidate, verified refinement transport for workflows candidate via Lean4Agent/TLA+ legs). SUPERIOR-CONCEPTION NOTE carried per the supreme law and CF P1-8: retargeting the trusted kernel to a verified-compilation substrate (CakeML/Brack) removes the diverse-double-execution mitigation from the compiler link and is excluded only by the declared SBCL commitment — a RESOURCE_BOUNDED scope choice, declared, not a limit

tcb-minimized-root: enumerated, hash-committed TCB with full-source bootstrap (StageX/live-bootstrap), reproducible builds (Debian-grade policy gates), binary transparency, TEE attestation binding OMS-signed model weights and harness code to outputs (absorbs: attested-execution-bound-to-transparency-log candidate, binary/firmware transparency candidate, cross-hardware attested determinism candidate, qualification-packaging candidate)

eliminations.lemma: Pre-registered dominance conjecture on AX-21: R1-R2 while the frozen guarantee profile shows machine-checked spec properties (R3) are attainable with an offline-vendored Lean 4 toolchain; no compensating advantage conjectured. Adjudicated by full verdicts against retained representative K-HUM.

Violates H1 and H8: the assurance verdict is a statistical output and is not recomputable by a zero-trust third party. Kernel-checked alternatives exist at expert-novel difficulty (Aristotle IMO 2025: no proof, no answer).

Pre-registered dominance conjecture on AX-21: benchmarks transport no property to the executable (capped R1-R2 — committed guarantees not tracked as objects), while per-output-translation-validation achieves checkable per-artifact guarantees at comparable cost. Adjudicated by full verdicts against retained representatives K-COM and K-AGT.
